item.description:
What's new in 0.1.44

  • New: a featured 3D Mate integration at the top of Apps & Tools. If you use 3D Mate (the local image/photo/video to 3D app), turn it on and AwakeMate holds your Mac awake while a model is generating - detected automatically from 3D Mate's own generation processes, including the texture and retopo steps - then lets it sleep when done. If you don't have 3D Mate yet, the card links you to it. Off by default.
